The following events took place in '''3683 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Jace Malcom]] joins the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] as an [[Republic Army|Army]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="AlderaanBonus">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Bonus Series|Alderaan}}</ref><ref name="3683bby">During the Alderaan Bonus Series mission, Malcom states to the player character that the has <nowiki>"[f]</nowiki>''orty years of soldiering''" as experience. According to [https://web.archive.org/web/20110716175922/http://www.swtor.com/community/showthread.php?p=5365704 this forum post] from ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} lead writer, [[Daniel Erickson]], the game takes place approximately ten years after the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], placing Malcom's comments in approximately [[3643 BBY]]. Simple math shows he therefore began his military career around [[3683 BBY]].</ref>
*The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Parnax]] disappears and is assumed [[Death/Legends|dead]].<ref name="Lord Parnax's Lost Recordings">{{TORcite|type=codex|Lord Parnax's Lost Recordings}}</ref>
